startTime.description: Epoch-based start time for reward queries.

endTime.description: Epoch-based end time for reward queries.

return.description: The staking return for all validators for the period

apr.description: The APR for validators based on the return, total stake of the network and assuming 82125 epochs a year

aprPercentage.description: The same as above but in percentage form

apy.description: The APY based on the above and assuming re-staking of all rewards after each epoch (Unlikely for ETH but kept in for completeness)

apyPercentage.description: The same as above but in percentage form

denomination.description: the denomination the reward is in

stake.description: the total stake across the full network

effectiveBalance.description: The effective balance of the validator at the start time

mevBlockReward.description: The total mev block rewards in the period

blockReward.description: The total block rewards in the period

syncCommitteeReward.description: The sync comittee rewards for the period

attestationReward.description: The attestation rewards for the period

epoch.description: The epoch number/s that the period covers

protocolRewards.description: The total protocol rewards in the period

mevRewards.description: The total mev block rewards in the period

blockRewards.description: The total block fee rewards in the period

totalBalance.description: The total balance of the validators in the network (including pending withdrawals)
